heard: The brightest star in the night sky is wobbling. An invisible companion is pulling it off course. Astronomer Friedrich Bessel first deduced this ghost star. Alfred Clark finally saw the dim spark in 1862. It was a white dwarf, a tiny cooling stellar core. Walter Adams analyzed its light in 1915. Sirius B packs the sun's entire mass into Earth's volume. One cubic inch of this material weighs over a ton. This crushing density is the cause.
